assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
z_floor=3.0m for 2F assumed equal to 1F ceiling_height pending elevation storey-height check.
Ceiling height 3.0m and door/window heights assumed pending elevation check.
West window jamb pixels approximated as mirror of east window; not independently measured to the same precision.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

generation.notes: Deterministic plan partition compilation from explicit original-image pixels. Calibration and drawing fidelity remain unverified.
unresolved: Neither large north conference room (RoomN1, RoomN2) shows any door or open passage to Corridor2F, the north exterior wall, or each other in this drawing; they also have no exterior door of their own. As drawn they are physically enclosed with only windows for openings. This is preserved as observed rather than inventing a connection; it may reflect an omission in the source drawing or a connection not visible at this drawing's scope (e.g. a sliding/folding partition not rendered as a door symbol).
No exterior door is visible anywhere on 2F (north, south, east or west); vertical circulation (stair) reaching this floor is not shown in the supplied plan and is not modeled.
South window subdivisions were read from a weak/sparse color profile; exact widths carry modest pixel-reading uncertainty.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.
